hypothesis: Cells come in different variance regimes; a two-component mixture of HBK models fitted by ML on the training cells, with the component chosen by the new cell's reads, predicts the adjacent log SF better than the single HBK@ML on the same reads.
contract: As attempts 2/4: k+1 metals read by gen20's DOPT_Q, only their differences used; mixture of two HBK components (the fold's ML kernel family) fitted by weighted ML on the outer training cells; prediction = component posterior from the reads x component conditional means; nothing tuned on held-out cells.
